name: glossary-tap
does: A Glossary tab over the course's TERMS (a data file listed in course.js `files`): every term with its one-line meaning, definition, a situation that shows it in action, the professor's example, its figure (a key of diagrams.js DIA) and its source, with a search box (names that match first, then terms that only mention the word), a letter bar, by-group or A-Z order and group chips; and, after an answer is shown, the first mention of each term in a question's explanations, and in each section of the Guides, Tell apart and Reference tabs, can be tapped to open its definition under the line. A term the core's glossary.js GLOSS has already defined in brackets there is left to the core.
source: Intro-Pharmacology exam1-drill/src/app.js lines 1771-1922 (termLetter, termHTML, glossWire and the glossary branch of vTerms) and shell.html lines 213, 238, 251-253, 295-296, at 929cd62, re-found by function name (the port queue took lines 1769-1922 at d0d3d2d, which the read-only clone does not hold); the tap part is written for the kit

label.about: the tab's name in the nav

before.about: the tab it is placed before

tap.about: terms in explanations and reading tabs can be tapped for their definition

notTapped.about: ids of terms the tap leaves alone (a word the course uses in nearly every sentence, such as 'drug')
